competitive_position.claim: Target competes with omnichannel retailers including department stores, off-price general merchandise retailers, wholesale clubs, category-specific retailers, drug stores, supermarkets, direct-to-consumer brands, online marketplaces, and other forms of retail commerce.
quotes: We compete with omnichannel retailers, including department stores, off-price general merchandise retailers, wholesale clubs, category-specific retailers, drug stores, supermarkets, direct-to-consumer brands, online marketplaces, and other forms of retail commerce.

competitive_position.claim: A threat to Target's competitive position is that consumers can quickly comparison shop using digital tools and may make decisions based solely on price or convenience, limiting Target's ability to differentiate.
quotes: Since consumers can quickly comparison shop using digital tools, they may make decisions based solely on price or convenience, which could limit our ability to differentiate from our competitors.

competitive_position.claim: A threat is that advances in artificial intelligence may enable new competitors to emerge due to lowered barriers to entry in digital retail, and Target may be unable to match or surpass competitors' AI capabilities.
quotes: As technology (including artificial intelligence) in the digital retail market continues to evolve, new competitors may emerge due to lowered barriers to entry, which could negatively impact our ability to compete.

competitive_position.claim: A threat is that Target has not always been able to accurately forecast consumer demand, which has previously resulted in insufficient or excess inventory, increased markdowns, and higher costs.
quotes: We have not always been able to accurately forecast consumer demand or react to rapid changes in consumer preferences and spending patterns, which has previously resulted in insufficient or excess inventory, increased inventory markdowns, higher costs (including for storage, transportation, labor, and other expenses), and adverse impacts on our results of operations.

competitive_position.claim: A threat is reputational damage from ESG, social, and political initiatives, including consumer boycotts organized throughout 2025 following Target's modification and conclusion of certain diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives.
quotes: in 2025, we announced that we modified and concluded certain of our initiatives related to diversity, equity, and inclusion, which resulted in adverse reactions from some of our shareholders, guests, team members, and others, as well as consumer boycotts organized throughout 2025.

competitive_position.basis: stated in 10-K Item 1, 10-K MD&A, and 10-Q MD&A
competitive_position.claim: A threat is tariff volatility: approximately one-half of Target's merchandise is sourced from outside the U.S., with China the largest country of origin, and the collective interaction of tariffs, sourcing strategies, pricing actions, and consumer response could materially impact sales and results.
quotes: Approximately one-half of the merchandise we offer is sourced from outside the United States, with China representing the largest country of origin for imported goods.

The collective interaction of tariffs, tariff refunds, sourcing strategies, pricing actions, consumer response and behaviors, and other factors could materially impact our sales, results of operations, and financial condition in future periods.

in 2025, we recognized costs and charges related to reductions in our workforce, facility exits, and the termination of a commercial partnership.

sustained high rates of inventory shrink at certain stores have contributed, and may continue to contribute, to the closure of certain stores and the impairment of long-term assets.

risks.basis: stated in P2; counter also from P2
risks.claim: Target has experienced past disruptions to digital order fulfillment and point-of-sale systems and a prominent data breach, and warns that evolving cyber threats including AI-enhanced attacks could severely interrupt operations and draw greater scrutiny.
quotes: in the past, we have experienced disruptions to the order fulfillment capabilities on our digital platforms and in our point-of-sale system that prevented our ability to process debit or credit transactions, which negatively impacted some guests' experiences and generated negative publicity.
we previously experienced a prominent data breach, additional information security, cybersecurity, or data privacy incidents could draw greater scrutiny.

risks.basis: stated in P4; counter from P4 and P3
risks.claim: SG&A expense rate rose to 21.7 percent in H1 2026 from an adjusted 21.5 percent in H1 2025, driven by higher compensation, new store and remodel-related expenses, and other cost increases.
quotes: For the six months ended August 1, 2026, our SG&A expense rate was 21.7 percent compared with 20.3 percent for the comparable prior-year period.

The remaining 0.2 percentage point increase in 2026 reflected higher compensation expense, including stores payroll and incentive compensation, new store and remodel-related expenses, and the net impact of other cost increases.

unresolved_questions.claim: The ultimate financial effects of all IEEPA tariff refunds, beyond the $994 million already recognized in Q2 2026, remain unestimable by the company
quotes: Because the process, timing, and amount of any recovery are uncertain, we are unable to estimate the financial effects, if any, at this time.

due to uncertainties related to the refund process, timing, and amount of potential refunds, as well as ongoing legal and regulatory developments, we are unable to estimate the ultimate financial effects of any potential additional tariff refunds.

unresolved_questions.claim: The amount and timing of additional business transformation costs and charges Target may incur in future periods cannot be reasonably estimated
quotes: We may incur additional business transformation costs and charges in future periods, which may adversely affect our results of operations and financial condition; however, we cannot reasonably estimate the amount of such costs and charges at this time.

We may incur additional costs and charges related to these initiatives in future periods, which may adversely affect our results of operations and financial condition; however, we cannot reasonably estimate the amount or timing of such costs or charges.

unresolved_questions.basis: Stated in the 10-K MD&A (P3) and 10-Q MD&A (P4) as a material uncertainty; no quantification provided
unresolved_questions.claim: The collective impact of new tariffs instituted by the U.S. administration after the IEEPA ruling on Target's sales, results of operations, and financial condition in future periods is unknown
quotes: We are closely monitoring the evolving consumer and regulatory landscape, including new tariffs announced in February 2026 in response to the U.S. Supreme Court ruling on IEEPA tariffs, and adjusting plans as needed. The collective interaction of tariffs, sourcing strategies, pricing actions, consumer response and behaviors, and other factors, could materially impact our sales and results of operations in future periods.
The U.S. administration has instituted new tariffs against most major trading partners. We continue to assess and respond to the evolving consumer, legal and regulatory environment.

quotes: In 2025, we reached a mutual agreement with Ulta Beauty to terminate our commercial shop-in-shop operating agreement when it expires in August 2026.

unresolved_questions.claim: The timing and total amount of customs duty refunds Target will receive under the first sale methodology, a significant portion of which have processing and payment cycles extending beyond one year, are uncertain
quotes: We generally pay duties based on the price Target pays its vendors for the goods, and later seek refunds for qualifying transactions by filing first sale claims, a significant portion of which have processing and payment cycles that extend beyond one year.

P4.s58.text: (a)Includes $994 million related to tariff refunds for the three and six months ended August 1, 2026, which provided a benefit to Gross margin rate, Operating income rate, and Adjusted operating income rate of 3.7 percentage points and 1.9 percentage points for the three and six month periods, respectively.

P4.s6.text: •A comparable sales increase of 3.8 percent, reflecting a 3.6 percent increase in traffic and a 0.2 percent increase in average transaction amount;

P6.s32.text: •Full-year net sales growth in a range around 5 percent, one percentage point higher than the prior guidance range.
